# Vasudev Darse Shikari (DS Vasudev)
> Full Stack Engineer specializing in Java Full Stack, MERN Stack, Agentic AI & MCP Servers, and fueling early-stage startups through software engineering and freelancing.

## About
Vasudev Darse Shikari is an independent Software Engineer based in Hyderabad, India. He builds enterprise-grade microservice backends, modern React/Next.js front ends, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that connect AI agents with production APIs. As a passionate developer interested in freelancing and helping startups launch production platforms, Vasudev offers full-stack development, agentic AI integrations, and system architecture services.

## Core Services & Freelance Offerings

## Key Projects
1. **ElevateHub:** AI-native learning management system & AI solutions suite — AI Interview Coach, Skill Gap Analyzer, AI Resume Builder, RAG vector Q&A engine, and real-time trainee skill graph.
2. **CORE (AI Native Collaborative Organizational Resource Engine):** Enterprise startup management platform built with DDD & microservices — MCP servers let AI agents delegate tasks and execute platform actions in natural language.
3. **Portfolio MCP Connector:** Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exposing profile, projects, skills, system design, and calendar booking as callable tools for AI agents like Claude & ChatGPT.
4. **DigiSchool Apps:** Upcoming AI-powered platform for managing whole school operations (staff, students, academics, attendance, and administrative workflows) across 8 microservices.
5. **Co-Investing Platform (Kupa Inc):** Co-investment workflows and real-time portfolio tracking for high-net-worth investors across multiple asset classes.
6. **ProjeXpert:** Enterprise project management platform built on Node.js, Express, React, MySQL, and GitHub API.
7. **SmartTransit System:** Microservices-based public transit system utilizing Java Spring Boot, Netflix Eureka, Ola Maps API, and Docker.
8. **Vehicle Rentals System:** Vehicle rental marketplace with vendor listings, reservations, and Angular/React interfaces built on Spring Boot.
9. **Chatterbox:** Real-time chat app built with Node.js, Express, Socket.IO, and React.
10. **Banking Website:** Secure banking web portal with robust multi-layered architecture.
11. **roughAge E-Commerce:** Produce delivery platform built on React, Node.js, and MongoDB.
